entities.name: Protestant Reformation
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The religious revolution (1517–1648) that split Western Christianity. Triggered by Martin Luther's Ninety-Five Theses, it challenged papal authority, produced new Protestant denominations, and culminated in devastating religious wars that reshaped European politics.
